recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Further source edits would be redundant unless FHIR-I reopens the substantive semantics of optional fixed or pattern constraints.
issue_request: FHIR-28126 was Published/Persuasive for R5 and asked FHIR-I to clarify that if min = 0 and a fixed or pattern value is provided, the fixed or pattern value only applies if the element is present.
initial_application: The issue was explicitly applied by git commit 1736091b56105ca469a08c4d7a91976dfe2346e8, which added the min/max rule to source/elementdefinition.html and updated ElementDefinition definition text. Later commit 343a3ba4e9d0644658fd45f04c0218edcdd0dcac added the explicit omitted-element sentence now present in the same rule.
additional_context: The originating Zulip thread reached consensus that validators should ignore fixed/pattern validation when an optional element is absent, aside from cardinality. FHIR-I minutes from 2020-11-09 record the 11-0-0 persuasive vote. ElementDefinition is active and normative in source/fhir.ini, and related pattern wording audits FHIR-33316 and FHIR-36700 are already represented on the combined branch.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The latest combined branch already contains the min=0 fixed/pattern bullet, the omitted-element clarification, and consistent fixed[x]/pattern[x] definition wording.

related_jiras.note: Separate published pattern[x] wording cleanup in the same ElementDefinition source; already audited on the combined branch.
Separate published clarification of pattern[x] repeating and array semantics; already audited on the combined branch.

evidence_items.summary: Published/Persuasive issue requesting clarification that fixed or pattern values on min=0 elements apply only when the element is present.
evidence_items.learned: This establishes the final issue request and target semantics.

evidence_items.summary: The active ElementDefinition min/max rules state that with min=0, a fixed or pattern value applies only if the element is present, and omission is not treated as specifying that value or pattern.
evidence_items.learned: The current source already implements the approved clarification.

evidence_items.summary: fixed[x] says the value applies in the instance if present, and pattern[x] qualifies matching by whether the element has a value.
evidence_items.learned: The ElementDefinition definition text is consistent with FHIR-28126.
